title: Replacing Judges with Juries: Evaluating LLM Generations with a Panel of Diverse Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the deviation of individual LLM judges' scores from human annotator ground truth, specifically observing the absolute accuracy score delta to identify if an evaluator model disproportionately favors its own generated outputs (e.g., GPT-4 ranking its own generations higher than their actual human-evaluated Chatbot Arena ELO rank).
